node.title: All-coordinate pair-rank descent including nonregular children
node.statement: All original-weight coordinate sections of W subset V squared, rank2s-c>s, have joint ranks0/1/2 and shared dimension s-1. Rank<=1 coordinates number at most kappa+c; rank0 at most kappa+floor(c/2). Full-generic parents have no rank0, preserve genericity at rank1, and can lose it at rank2. Nested exceptional charges give exact U/G recurrences with full gcds, nonincreasing degree excess and unchanged owners; no source budget is assumed.
